method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: compilation of the Act from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 48361, retrieved 7 September 2026); no compilation number stated; latest amendments shown are the Firearms Act 2024 (No. 23 of 2024) ss 485-487 and the Criminal Law (Mental Impairment) Act 2023 (No. 10 of 2023); with the Security and Related Activities (Control) Regulations 1997 as deposited at ../../../security-and-related-activities-control-regulations-1997 (mrdoc 49704, version 07-ae0-00, currency from 1 July 2026, retrieved 20 October 2026), Schedule 4 fees as inserted by SL 2026/115 ($434 a licence for up to 3 years, $135 for fingerprints)
